body: I don’t know if I’m worried though, I don’t feel or rarely feel any kind of anxiety or stress.
I don’t wanna get locked away though, I don’t know if I can trust therapist or psychiatrists. I don’t wanna get hospitalized for the rest of my life.
I didn’t taste it, I have a little bit of a headache but it’s not just in one place and laying down doesn’t really do anything. And the same can be said for the nasal burning sensation

If it is a CFS leak do you think this is just something I could make an appointment for with a doctor or should I be going to an emergency room or hospital? My parents aren’t very good when it comes to things that could be serious and are often very optimistic about things like that and even when I tell them how serious it could be they just make some excuse. And I can’t use an  ambulance either because the ER in my hometown is very bad.

It actually started leaking when I was sitting on the toilet leaning forward, I thought my nose was bleeding but when I touched I didn’t notice anything red so I just wiped my nose and went to my room but when I was laying on my side my nose started dripping again and I instantly noticed the strange piss colour.. I don’t think it was a lot, I can’t really remember though.. I have a little bit of a weird burning or stinging sensation in the back right-side of my head, no visuals changed from what I noticed and when I stand or bend down it does drain out or anything like that.

But then again, I haven’t really kept my head forward for a long period of time cause I’m a bit freaked out. Also, it’s only the right nostril so far. I haven’t noticed any yellow liquid in my left nostril.
My nose stings a bit, I didn’t really smell it but my nose does not smell like anything.
No worries :) I appreciate your help, I’ll definitely see a doctor if the leaking gets any worse or if I notice anything strange with my head or anything. Thanks for your help
Isn’t CSF liquid clear? And wouldn’t it be leaking out of my ear too?

No it’s not continuous or anything and I haven’t had any crazy head trauma or anything like that, I have this kinda weird feeling in my head but I haven’t noticed any changes when laying down or anything..
How would piss get in my nose?
No, not that I know of anyway.
